command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "cli|eval|ci" | cut -c1-200; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -80; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -120

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -40; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -60

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools call --help 2>&1 | grep -iE "param|args|--" | head; mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals
cat > .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arith_add
  name: Arithmetic fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: fixture
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_adds
    title: uses add for 2+3
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 17 plus 25? Use the tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
cat > .mcp.json <<'E'
{"mcpServers":{"fixture":{"url":"http://fixture:8765/mcp"}}}
E
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml 2>&1 | head -20; env | grep -ciE "ANTHROPIC|OPENAI"
